background.value: light grey, light blue, or white; plain, single color, single shade; must provide sufficient contrast with head

head_height.value: 26-30mm chin to crown (ages 11+); 19-30mm (under 11); face width 16-20mm excluding ears

validity.value: taken within 6 months (no more than 6 months old when application is submitted)

file_spec.value: minimum 400 dpi resolution, high-quality smooth photo paper, color, sharp with sufficient contrast and detail

expression_restriction.value: neutral expression, mouth closed, looking straight at camera

glasses_policy.value: permitted if eyes are fully visible, lenses fully transparent, no distortion or shadows from reflection

ears_visibility.value: ears need not be visible if full face width (16-20mm) is shown

face_visibility.value: face fully visible, eyes fully visible, head shown in full and centered

headwear_policy.value: not permitted; exceptions for religious or belief-based head coverings (must be plain, single color, contrasting with background) and medical hair loss coverings

accessories.value: earrings and facial piercings permitted; beards, wigs, makeup allowed; no reflection from accessories
